issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the problem statement UML (class Lecture in problem_statement.md) specifies the method returns a double, but the solution implementation declares public int getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() and performs integer division. The template contains only a TODO placeholder for this method. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and leads to truncated integer results instead of a floating-point ratio.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Either (A) change the solution method to return a double and compute a floating-point ratio: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return ((double) getTotalNumberOfStudents()) / getNumberOfTutors(); } — this matches the UML and avoids integer truncation; or (B) if integer division was intended, update the problem statement UML and documentation to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int and note integer division behavior.
